runner-port.rule: Behavior-preserving port: every export kept, >=80% line similarity after .ts->.js normalization, must-contain tokens present

backlog-tracing.rule: makeTracingPlugin({serviceName:'adhd'}) configured once in src/tracing.ts, mounted in every usePlugins array, package singleton never imported

entrypoint-structure.rule: Top-level files, tags, package metadata and nx targets conform to the common set of dispatch-cli/backlog/apigen-cli
